phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, opponent shows a ground posture with Marines or Marauders. Your own posture is unknown but with heavy tech investment.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's composition or when you reach a tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize ground army and economy, maintain production, continue tech. Avoid air overcommit.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground forces, increase economy, and increase production. Continue technology development.
phase_policies.title: Early Ground Tech Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air or neglect ground defense while focusing solely on tech.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, opponent shows a ground posture with Marines, Siege Tanks, Marauders, or Reapers. Your own posture is ground-oriented with heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent's air presence or army composition changes, or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on ground army and economy, maintain production, continue tech. Avoid air overcommit.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground forces, increase economy, and maintain or increase production. Continue technology development. Consider adding Siege Tanks or Reapers based on opponent cues.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro with Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air or neglect ground defense while focusing solely on tech.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, opponent shows a ground posture with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, and possibly Battlecruisers. Your own posture is ground with heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you confirm the opponent's air transition or when your army composition is ready.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army, increase economy, continue tech. Prepare air contingency for Battlecruisers.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground strength, increase economy, and continue technology. Consider adding air units or upgrades to counter potential Battlecruisers.
phase_policies.title: Ground Strength with Air Contingency
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground without preparing for a potential air transition to Battlecruisers.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, opponent shows moderate air presence with Hellions and Medivacs, indicating a possible drop play. Your own posture is ground with moderate air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have sufficient anti-drop defenses or when the opponent's composition becomes clearer.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Increase air for drop defense, strengthen ground, expand, continue tech. Avoid neglecting ground defense.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence and continue strengthening ground forces. Maintain economy and expand further. Continue technology and upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Ground with Air Defense
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground defense while focusing on air or expansion, leaving you vulnerable to the opponent's ground army.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
